AC1.note: python-implementation SKILL.md description/triggers fixed after offline trigger-only diagnosis (keryx skills scout); full bundled-catalog trigger regression 110/110 pos, 108/108 neg. Commit 6b878fe1.

AC2.note: RUNNER_SYSTEM_NOTE + RUNNER_PROMPT_VERSION added, bound by pack gate; no-sleep-sync fail_criteria reviewed and fixed against recorded evidence (select+time.After deadline guard vs fixed delay). Commits 412b2dc2, 454175e7.

AC3.note: keryx skills eval --reverify implemented (reverifyPackSample), unit-tested with stub judge, documented in CLI reference threat-model section. Commit 5cadbf3e.

AC6.note: getter-accessor known-right variant documented in pass_criteria/known_right (schema supports only one known_right string, so a rubric note not a schema change). Commit b39e81f6.

AC7.note: Calibration re-recorded (judge-check --record) for every touched scenario, all green; honest gate run at trials=10 over all 18 skills; governance/eval.json rebuilt from raw outputs; pack.json/install-manifest stability updated (python/go stable, ts-js-node experimental); agent pairs regenerated; W1/W2 docs, CLI reference, guide updated. Commit df55b49a, 9013e29e, 6c31e5fb.

AC8.note: No SKILL.md or grader edited to force a pass; every rubric/calibration change justified in journal.md with recorded evidence (no-sleep-sync, no-nolint-suppression, getter-accessor).

AC9.note: PR #702 merged into feat/agent-platform-expansion as 009c13ba. Review round 1: 0 blocker/major/minor/info. Round 2 (narrow, CI-driven fix): 0 new findings. CI green on all checks.
